_docs: One entry per badge id in apps/math/badges.json. rarity drives the frame metal + enamel field (see SKILL.md). shape: coin (default) | hex. motif: the symbol, described for slim raised line-art. orb: the center gradient, 'top color → bottom color'.

first-steps.motif: a small sprout — a short stem rising from a single seed with two symmetric rounded leaves curving upward
first-steps.orb: bright cyan at the top fading to fresh spring-green at the bottom

ten-quizzes.motif: a flexed strong arm doing a bicep curl, drawn as one bold continuous curved line
ten-quizzes.orb: teal at the top fading to green at the bottom

on-a-roll.motif: a single tongue of flame made of three nested upward-curling strokes
on-a-roll.orb: warm orange at the top fading to golden yellow at the bottom

century.motif: the number 100 in elegant connected single-stroke script, flanked by two small laurel sprigs
century.orb: bright azure at the top fading to deep blue at the bottom

flawless.motif: a four-point sparkle star with two tiny twinkles beside it
flawless.orb: sky-cyan at the top fading to sapphire at the bottom

week-warrior.motif: a calendar page with a folded top corner and a bold check-mark across it
week-warrior.orb: azure at the top fading to deep blue at the bottom

comeback-kid.motif: a circular looping return arrow that curls into a small star at its tip
comeback-kid.orb: teal at the top fading to blue at the bottom

daredevil.motif: a bold lightning bolt crossing a pair of cool sunglasses
daredevil.orb: electric blue at the top fading to deep blue at the bottom

topic-tamer.motif: three interlocking jigsaw puzzle pieces arranged in a triangle
topic-tamer.orb: aqua at the top fading to teal at the bottom

five-hundred.motif: a 3x3 counting frame (abacus) with rows of beads on rods
five-hundred.orb: magenta at the top fading to violet at the bottom

perfectionist.motif: a bullseye of three concentric rings with an arrow striking the exact center
perfectionist.orb: magenta at the top fading to violet at the bottom

fortnight.motif: a calendar page showing the number 14, wrapped by a small laurel
fortnight.orb: violet at the top fading to indigo at the bottom

three-weeks.motif: a calendar page showing the number 21 with a small flame rising above it
three-weeks.orb: violet at the top fading to magenta at the bottom

brave-heart.motif: a noble lion's head with a flowing mane drawn from radiating curved strokes
brave-heart.orb: warm amber at the top fading to violet at the bottom

topic-master.motif: a five-point crown with small round gem dots on its tips
topic-master.orb: violet at the top fading to gold at the bottom

accuracy-ace.motif: a star medal hanging from a short pleated ribbon
accuracy-ace.orb: violet at the top fading to royal blue at the bottom

math-machine.motif: a friendly robot head built from clean geometric lines, with a single antenna and two round eyes
math-machine.orb: bright cyan at the top sweeping to lime-green at the bottom-left, like an Earth marble

sharp-shooter.motif: a drawn longbow with a nocked arrow, rendered as one elegant continuous line
sharp-shooter.orb: warm gold at the top fading to amber at the bottom

unstoppable.motif: a rocket climbing upward with a looping vapor trail and three small stars
unstoppable.orb: bright cyan at the top sweeping to lime-green at the bottom

two-months.motif: a laurel wreath encircling the number 60, crowned by a small flame
two-months.orb: warm gold at the top sweeping to orange at the bottom, like a flame
